newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open little changed Tuesday, floor sources said.

Some dealers said the market could head lower after benchmark October reached resistance pegged at a gap on the charts between 11.52 and 11.55 cents a lb and then failed to move higher. Resistance was pegged at 11.55 cents followed by the recent high of 11.87 cents, with support at 11.32 cents.
Monday, October settled up 0.15 cent at 11.53 cents after trading from 11.55 to 11.37 cents. The rest ended 0.10 to 0.16 cent firmer.
An estimated 12,678 lots changed hands on the day.
In London, white sugar futures were tightly mixed in slim trading Tuesday. LIFFE October was up 10 cents to $323.00, and the back months 40 cents higher to 10 cents lower, as of 0835 EDT/1235 GMT.
